RT by @DXBMediaOffice: I met with H.E. Choi Kyo-jin, Minister of Education of the Republic of South Korea, to exchange perspectives on the future of education and its role in preparing generations to navigate rapid change and shape the future. We discussed the importance of expanding cooperation between educational institutions in the UAE and South Korea, exchanging expertise and innovative practices, and harnessing modern technologies to advance education systems and enhance the quality of education and its outcomes. These efforts can help equip future generations with the knowledge and skills they need to thrive in a rapidly changing world.

Dubai South signs an agreement with Phoenix Aviation to develop a new airside facility at the Mohammed bin Rashid Aerospace Hub. Scheduled for completion in Q1 2029, the project will establish a centre of excellence specialising in wide-body aircraft maintenance, repair and overhaul (MRO), cabin modifications and completions, and cargo conversions, catering to growing demand for specialised aviation services.
